parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the two rocker switches on the wall switch assembly, made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning an electrical circuit on or off when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks around a central axis to make or break the electrical connection.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second rocker switch on the wall switch assembly, also made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, functioning identically to the first switch.
parts.Movement_description: It rocks back and forth to open or close the circuit, providing tactile feedback.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the wall switch, made of ABS plastic for rigidity and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switches in place and provides structural support and electrical insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
